g.text: Fixes are checked the same way
Trust layer 2/2: briefs, the faithfulness judge, contradictions and review labels.
The model says
Code checks it before anyone sees it
Brief drafts for the top 8 gaps
Sources must exist in the listing or its image claims.
Every number must appear in a source, or the draft
becomes a request to the brand.
Faithfulness judge:
unsupported statements
It can only remove claims, never add them.
A hidden answer is moved word for word:
the brand's image text, chosen in code.
Grade: contradicted
Never guessed, never drafted. The brand is asked:
“Which is right: X or Y?”
Review labels: supports, contradicts,
mixed, unrelated
Index range and label enum checked. Rates in code with
a Wilson 95% interval; under 30 matching reviews:
“not enough evidence”.
Real example, hero listing. Image: “Each Pen is Sealed with Wax to Prevent ink from Drying”
Model's draft: “... to prevent ink from drying out and leaking”
The judge flagged “and leaking”, so the draft was held back.
